$comment: Unmet criteria are never counted or labelled by their landing reason (project 34zzTeZx49jI9ndWIsQEF, criterion 5; board gaps G1/G2). A project shaped like Coordinator handoff v2: four unmet criteria whose landing lanes say NO_RECEIPT (two) and NO_BRANCH (two: one never run, one never run and declared codeless, which since 2caec7aae9 no longer decides landing), and one met criterion IN_FLIGHT. The server's derivedDone.counts tally only met criteria by where their work is (onMain + byReason add up to met); landed counts met LANDED criteria only. Clients count unmet criteria apart ('N not met'), and the done card's 'N items running' is read from the criteria (landingReason IN_FLIGHT, met or not), not from counts.byReason. Whether the project can be recorded as done is unchanged: derivedDone.withheld is read over every criterion. Read by the apiserver's project-looks-finished.pg.spec.ts case (6), which also holds the done check (doneCheck: severity, code, criterion ordinal) to it, web's projectDone.unmetCounts.test.ts, and the iOS (OrbitKit) and Android tests of the Done tally / Record as done confirmation.
